The target video is three separate music-video shots of a living wet watercolor painting, the pigment blooming and drifting as everything moves.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. Seen from directly above, the flower opens fast like a time-lapse, petals unfolding in a spiral, while the camera slowly rotates clockwise and rises, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>. Handheld and shaking slightly, the glowing roots surge and split the stone, cracks of light racing outward and fragments falling away, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>. The camera holds low and still as the wave smashes into the wall and the violet spray bursts upward across the frame, droplets hitting the lens, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
